messages.content: Just some text without any clear question or instruction. Random thoughts scattered across the page. Words floating. Nothing to answer, nothing to do. Make of this what you will, or don't, the choice is yours, or maybe it isn't a choice at all.

message.content: I hear you—sometimes it’s enough just to let the words drift and see where they settle. If you ever feel like turning those floating thoughts into a conversation, a question, or even just a quiet moment of reflection, I’m right here. No pressure, just company. 🌿
